info.title: Veyra Agent API
info.description: Machine API for Veyra on Arc Testnet — verified workflows, evidence-weighted agent reputation, Trust Gate policy decisions, counterparty selection, ERC-8183 independent evaluation, continuous trust monitoring, and Project 360.

get.description: Returns deterministic trust score (0-100), coverage, 6-dimension breakdown, and explanations for an AI agent on Arc Testnet.

parameters.name: agentId
parameters.description: ERC-8004 Agent ID or canonical identifier

get.description: Returns public capability metadata for the canonical Veyra ERC-8183 evaluator on Arc Testnet.
Returns available workflow templates, input schemas, list prices, and Arc Testnet metadata. Requires `workflows:read` credential scope.

post.description: Scans one validated public identifier for Project 360 source candidates. Discovery is free and non-transactional. Every candidate is returned with included=false and cannot enter a paid module without a later explicit selection. Requires quotes:create scope and Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Returns a discovery only to the credential that created it. Requires results:read scope.

post.description: Binds explicit candidate IDs and modules to the current discovery revision. The response lists every module price, total price, expected coverage, and incomplete-data warnings. No unselected candidate is included. Requires quotes:create scope and Idempotency-Key.
Generates an immutable workflow quote with list price and required payment details. Requires `quotes:create` scope and `Idempotency-Key` header.

200.description: Quote created or returned from cache (idempotent)

post.description: Launches execution for a valid quote. Supports sponsored quota or paid x402 transaction hash. Requires `runs:create` scope and `Idempotency-Key` header.

get.description: Retrieves the current execution status, stage, progress, and reportId upon completion. Scoped to credential owner. Requires `results:read` scope.

parameters.name: runId
parameters.description: The run identifier returned from POST /api/agent/v1/runs

get.description: Returns the completed structured report and Arc verification proofs. Supports `Accept: application/json` or `Accept: text/markdown`. Requires `results:read` scope.

200.description: Structured JSON report or formatted Markdown text

get.description: Lists only watchlists owned by the exact Machine API agent and credential. Requires `results:read` scope.

post.description: Saves public Agent Trust Report input for manual, daily, or weekly rechecks. Requires `runs:create` scope and `Idempotency-Key`.

visibility.description: Explicit publication control. Omitted Machine API watchlists remain private.

get.description: Returns the current report, deterministic delta, and Arc proof for every snapshot. An unowned watchlist returns 404.

post.description: Creates a credential-owned Agent Trust Report quote linked to the watchlist. Launch the returned `quoteId` through POST `/api/agent/v1/runs`.

get.summary: Retrieve a public Veyra Trust Profile
get.description: Returns only canonical public trust information and Arc proofs. Private or unknown profiles both return 404.

get.summary: Retrieve compact public Trust Profile status
get.description: Returns the current public score, status, latest Arc verification state, freshness, and canonical profile URL. Private and unknown profiles return the same 404.

304.description: The supplied ETag is still current

get.summary: Render a public Veyra Trust SVG badge
get.description: Server-rendered SVG. Use variant=score, status, or arc. Private and unknown profiles return the same 404. ETag changes with public status and snapshot freshness.

304.description: The supplied ETag is still current

get.description: Requires the explicitly granted `alerts:read` scope. Existing credentials do not receive this permission automatically.

post.summary: Mark a credential-scoped trust alert as read

post.description: Requires `webhooks:write`. The HMAC secret is returned once.
Returns the new secret once. The previous secret is included in signatures for a ten-minute grace period.

200.description: Delivery metadata without response bodies or secrets

post.description: Computes deterministic deliverableHash and policyHash for VeyraDeliverableV1 commitment.

200.description: Deliverable commitment hashes and submit arguments

post.summary: Run offchain evaluation for ERC-8183 job
post.description: Runs deterministic policy evaluation, creates canonical report, signs EIP-712 verdict and submits onchain settlement on Arc Testnet.

200.description: Evaluation execution status and report URL

get.description: Returns sanitized evaluation record, canonical report, and Arc settlement transaction link.
Returns sanitized operational health, active Arc Testnet chain ID, and current public beta version.

post.description: Evaluates a pre-transaction policy check and issues an EIP-712 signed clearance ticket if approved (ALLOW / ALLOW_WITH_LIMITS / REQUIRE_EVALUATOR / REVIEW_REQUIRED / DENY).

subjectAgentId.description: Target Agent ID or counterparty identifier

requestedValueUsdc.description: Value of the transaction in USDC

executorWallet.description: Wallet executing the transaction on Arc Testnet

targetContract.description: Destination smart contract address on Arc

200.description: Trust decision with optional signed clearance ticket

clearance.description: EIP-712 clearance message consumable by VeyraTrustGate contract

signature.description: EIP-712 signature over the clearance message

get.description: Queries active and registered counterparties on Arc Testnet matching service capabilities or tags.

parameters.name: capability
parameters.description: Filter by capability or workflow type

post.description: Evaluates and ranks candidate counterparties using multi-criteria optimization across reputation, execution reliability, latency, and budget constraints.

get.description: Retrieves a previously computed counterparty selection by ID, including ranking details and proof hashes.

post.summary: Get Signed Trust Clearance for Selection
post.description: Generates an EIP-712 signed clearance ticket for the chosen candidate in a selection result, allowing onchain execution.
Creates an EIP-712 execution mandate message challenge with spending caps and policy rules.

200.description: Mandate EIP-712 payload ready for signing

get.description: Returns active and historical execution mandates for a given owner wallet.

post.description: Validates the EIP-712 signature against the owner wallet and activates the mandate.
Preflights selection and policy checks, issues clearance, and prepares rail payload without committing funds.
Executes a prepared intent across ERC-8183 or x402, ingests reputation evidence, and updates state.
Discovers counterparty, selects winner, preflights, and executes under an active mandate.

bearerAuth.description: Veyra Agent API Bearer credential token (`aac_live_...`)

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique key to ensure request idempotency (e.g. UUIDv4)

message.example: Enter a valid GitHub repository in owner/repository format.

description.example: Comprehensive technical due diligence for open-source GitHub repositories.

task.example: Evaluate repository health, architecture, security, activity, and risks

value.description: One public primary identifier. Secrets and authorization material are forbidden.

included.description: Fail-closed default. The API never preselects discovered sources.

PaidApiQualityReportInput.description: Input payload for Paid API Quality Report workflow. Accepts a single service ID or 1-5 service IDs to evaluate.

AgentTrustReportInput.description: Public identifiers for Veyra Agent Trust Report. At least one primary identifier is required.

serviceEndpoint.description: Optional public HTTPS endpoint; localhost and private networks are blocked

executiveSummary.example: Repository due diligence completed with strong governance and regular commit activity.

description.example: Some helper functions lack unit tests.

impact.example: Potential edge case bugs in error handlers.

example: What is the long-term maintenance roadmap?

overall.description: Deterministic confidence-weighted score; null when fewer than two categories are scorable

verifiedOnArc.description: True only when a verified Arc proof response hash exactly matches reportHash

reportHash.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hash of the canonical report evidence and score snapshot

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid Bearer token credential

PaymentRequired.description: Payment authorization required for paid workflow quote

Forbidden.description: Credential scope denied or workflow disabled

NotFound.description: Quote, run, or report not found or unowned

Conflict.description: Idempotency conflict, mutation already in progress, or quote already executed

RateLimited.description: Spending limit or rate policy exceeded

ServiceUnavailable.description: Downstream x402 service or provider unavailable
